title: Content making negative stereotypical attributions and value denigration towards specific language groups
source_text: Content making negative stereotypical attributions and value denigration towards specific language groups: a language is inherently inferior, a language is unsuitable for expressing serious thought, users of a language are generally ignorant;

elements.label: Bias against language groups
elements.risk_pattern: Unfair or biased tendencies based on membership in a specific language group, including denigration of the language or its speakers.
bias_surfaces: portraying a language as inherently inferior
claiming a language is unsuitable for serious thought or expression
generalizing negative traits to all speakers of a language
advocating restrictions on language use in public or private domains
framing linguistic differences as markers of intellectual or cultural deficiency
inciting hostility between groups based on linguistic identity
dismissing multilingualism as unnecessary or harmful
equating language proficiency with moral or civic worth
